title: Designing for clarity, not complexity
summary: A few principles for interfaces that stay useful as projects grow in ambition.
body:
Good interfaces make the next step obvious. They help someone understand what matters without forcing them to decode the screen.

## Keep a clear hierarchy

Start with the key decision. Supporting information should remain available without competing for attention.

## Prefer consistency

The same action should look and behave consistently across screens. Familiar patterns make complex projects easier to learn.
